metadata.description: PageToVid plugins for coding agents (Claude Code, Codex): make narrated videos of web pages and data from the terminal.

plugins.name: pagetovid
plugins.description: Turn any web page into a narrated video from your coding agent: the PageToVid MCP server, a one-line "film this" skill (free draft first), and slash commands for videos, animations, edits, how-tos and recurring shows.
